Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 23 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 23, 7:19 PM ET

Joe Burrow has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bengals at Commanders DraftKings Showdown: 22.6 points at $11,000 FLEX, 33.9 at captain for $16,500. Across 100,000 simulations Burrow holds 69% of the winning-lineup credit.

Ja'Marr Chase has the largest captain share: 17.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Chase at captain. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes. Jayden Daniels is the next captain in line, at 15.8%. The model has him running 5.8 times.

Cincinnati is a 6-point favorite, and the implied totals are 30.25 for the Bengals and 24.25 for the Commanders.

Behind Burrow, Chase and Daniels, the next projections are Chase Brown (17.8, $9,400), Tee Higgins (17.5, $10,600) and Stefon Diggs (13.1, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 23, 7:19 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Ja'Marr Chase, CIN WR ($11,600 FLEX / $17,400 CPT)

Ja'Marr Chase holds 17.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,400 and the 22.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Chase averaged 22.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 46.7. He holds 58% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.6% as the captain and 40.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 15.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 21.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.8 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Daniels averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 13.6 and a ceiling of 40.9. He holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.8% as the captain and 50.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Joe Burrow, CIN QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Joe Burrow holds 12.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 22.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Burrow averaged 22.6 points with a simulated floor of 12.5 and a ceiling of 41.4. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.3% as the captain and 56.6% in a FLEX spot.

Chase Brown, CIN RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations Brown averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 34.6. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.6% as the captain and 38.2% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Higgins averaged 17.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 40.9. Across 100,000 simulations Okonkwo averaged 11.2 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 25.8. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.5% as the captain and 37.2% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Perine averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 15.1. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.1% as the captain and 19.4% in a FLEX spot.

Mike Gesicki projects for 8.5 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.84 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.8 targets on 22.9 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Gesicki averaged 8.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.2 and a ceiling of 22.3. Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Ja'Marr Chase holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 17.6%, ahead of Jayden Daniels (15.8%) and Joe Burrow (12.3%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bengals vs Commanders?

Build around Tee Higgins at captain with Joe Burrow, Jayden Daniels and Chig Okonkwo at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (193 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Joe Burrow leads the SPAGS model at 22.6 DraftKings points for $11,000 at FLEX, or 33.9 points at captain for $16,500.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bengals vs Commanders Showdown?

Ja'Marr Chase is the most expensive player at $11,600 FLEX and $17,400 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Chig Okonkwo (11.2 points at $4,000), Samaje Perine (8.2 points at $4,400) and Mike Gesicki (8.5 points at $4,600).

What is the Bengals vs Commanders spread and total?

The Bengals are a 6-point favorite in a game totaled at 54.5, with implied team totals of 30.25 for the Bengals and 24.25 for the Commanders.
